nodes.description: address payable[] players; array holding the two participants of the current round
receive() payable external: accepts 0.01 ether minimum, pushes msg.sender as player, starts play() when 2 players
internal play(): picks winner via flipTheCoin(), clears players and pays out the whole balance
private payOut(address payable _to, uint _amount): performs low-level call transferring value
private view flipTheCoin(): returns random() % 2 used as winner index
public view random(): keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, players.length)
msg.sender used in receive() as the paying player address
block.timestamp used inside random() as entropy source
_to.call{value:_amount}("") low-level external value transfer in payOut
random() % 2 winner selection based on miner-influenceable block data
local address payable winner selected in play()
local bool sent holding the success flag of the low-level call

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by receive() as the address of the paying player
receive() writes msg.sender into the players state array
getPlayerCount reads players.length
receive() checks getPlayerCount() == 2 before starting a round
receive() calls play() once two players have paid
play() indexes players[flipTheCoin()] to obtain the winner
play() calls flipTheCoin() to choose the index
flipTheCoin() calls random() before applying modulo 2
random() entropy depends on block.timestamp, making the draw miner/timestamp dependent
the pseudo-random value is reduced by modulo 2 to select a winner
weak randomness determines which player receives the whole contract balance in play()
play() assigns players index to the local winner variable
play() calls clearPlayers() before payment
clearPlayers() deletes the players state array
play() calls getBalance() to compute the payout amount
the returned balance is used as the payout value
play() calls payOut(winner, getBalance())
the winner address becomes the _to argument of payOut
_to is the target of the low-level value call
_amount is the value forwarded by the low-level call
payOut() executes the low-level call transferring ether
the low-level call result is stored in the local bool sent
the winner contract can re-enter receive() during the external call and trigger another payout

normalization_plan.reason: parameter _to only exists to address the payout transfer performed by payOut and has no independent meaning
parameter _amount is solely the value forwarded by the unsafe low-level call
local winner is derived from players inside play() and is immediately passed to payOut
local sent only captures the success flag returned by the unsafe low-level call
